prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_flow] Express Starter Companion Flow: Rebuilds the adoption selection stage into a streamlined starter companion flow using interactive stage presets.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Pick Your Companion Archetype", "body": "Select a starter pet style to get up and running instantly."}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Redesigned Path Selection Hub: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a centered decision hub showcasing clear companion archetypes side-by-side.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "What Kind of Pet Companion Do You Want?", "body": "Choose a desktop buddy tailored for productivity, relaxation, or fun."}}
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Protection Hint: Adds an explanatory hint beneath sign-in options clarifying how sign-in protects pet data across app relaunches.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in anchors your pet to your cloud account so your pet's state and memory are safe."}}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Calibration Waiting Flow: Transforms the waiting step into a companion trait calibration flow with interactive progress indicators.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "show_progress": true, "headline": "Tuning Your Pet's Desktop Behavior", "body": "Adjust companion activity levels while your pet finishes loading."}}
4: [finish, redesign] Split Layout Interaction Showcase: Redesigns the home_intro finish screen into a split view showing key desktop control hotkeys and pet interaction tips.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "body": "Here is how to interact with your pet: right-click for options, drag to move, double-click to chat."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Persistent Profile Sign-In Copy: Updates sign_in screen headline and body text to highlight account syncing as pet backup security.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save & Protect Your Companion", "body": "Create or log into your account so your pet companion stays saved across sessions."}}
6: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Review Screen: Inserts a new summary screen before final certificate generation showing chosen pet traits.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_summary", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Review your companion details before completing adoption."}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Shortcut Quick Hint: Displays an inline helper hint on the finish screen explaining simple pet visibility controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: You can hide or call your pet anytime using your system tray or double-clicking its icon."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Pet Spawn Wait Estimate Info: Adds progress bar, time estimate, and notification option on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Preparing your desktop companion environment..."}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Role Description Copy: Clarifies choose_path options with descriptive copy contrasting active desk buddy versus background focus companion.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Desk Companion Type", "body": "Select whether you want an active interactive friend or a calm background presence."}}
